description: FILED s475 (Fable, 2026-09-07) from the s1061 merge review (#1508); CORRECTED the same session after reading the sites (the first draft counted THREE copies -- wrong: line ~2810 is `_push_item_is_scalar`, #1141's "definitely ONE scalar" question, and the #960 `substr()=` / `pos()` repair works on the emitted FORM (`_lvalue_target_form` -> `_write_through_form`, head-keyed), a different LAYER that is not a copy). WHAT IS DUPLICATED: the NODE-level question "is this node an element access of a container" has TWO predicates in Pl/ExprToCL.pm that differ by ONE conjunct: `_is_elem_arg` (~1873) answers a_acc / h_acc only and serves the `argbox` lvalue path at three call sites (~2574, ~3061, ~3109); `_is_elem_lvalue_target` (~1888, added by #1508) answers all four kinds (+ a_ref_acc / h_ref_acc) and serves the `=~ s///` / `=~ tr///` write-target gate at ~1410. #1508 wrote the second on purpose, and its reason is sound (`_is_elem_arg`'s consumers have no `-deref-argbox` runtime heads, so widening it would emit a name the runtime does not export) -- but the reason belongs on ONE predicate's flag, not in a second function: this is exactly how the deref omission recurred (#960 at pos(), then #1508 at =~). THE FIX (ease S, ~20 lines): one predicate `_elem_access_kind($node)` -> 'named' | 'deref' | undef; the argbox sites ask `eq 'named'` with the `-deref-argbox` reason as the comment beside that ONE line; the `=~` site asks `defined`; delete `_is_elem_lvalue_target`. BAR: a pure refactor -- emission-IDENTICAL over the four populations (corpus-diff 111 + emission-ab --shapes lib/**/*.pm + perl-tests + cpan-tests t/: 0 DIFF / 0 RCDIFF) + green gate is the bar (the s371 rule; no sweep); guards already exist: misc-fixes-02.t's #1508 rows and #960's rows. Owner: any Opus slot with spare time (s473a-f fillers). NOT urgent -- no behaviour is wrong today.
